stories.title: G7 leaders face wars abroad and divisions at home
stories.summary: President Trump and other G7 leaders meet in the French Alps this week as wars, economic uncertainty and strains in the transatlantic alliance loom over the summit.

stories.title: A Lebanon town's grief in the aftermath of a deadly Israeli airstrike
stories.summary: More than 3,700 people in Lebanon have died in the war between Israel and Hezbollah. In a village in southern Lebanon, one airstrike last month killed 14 people, including 10 women and children.

stories.title: Trump's name removed from Kennedy Center in secretive process
stories.summary: The removal of President Trump's name from the facade of the Kennedy Center after a judge's order was shrouded in secrecy. NPR's Frank Langfitt joined onlookers as workers hid the process from the public.

stories.title: Tribeca turns 25 with stars, surprises and standout indies
stories.summary: From a recording studio inside a Cameroon prison to a tribute to New York's retired MetroCard, the Tribeca Film Festival marked 25 years by spotlighting unexpected stories.

stories.title: World Cup online betting takes a toll in Brazil
stories.summary: A World Cup fever is sweeping Brazil. So is sports betting. NPR's Julia Carneiro reports on the country's gambling boom and the growing concerns about debt and addiction.

stories.title: What covering the World Series of Birding tells us about teen teamwork
stories.summary: Sleep-deprived teens, devoted dads, and hundreds of birds. NPR spends twenty four hours at the World Series of Birding.
